notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Canada's Fire Lookouts page for this name is a heading with only the Victoria County name, with no build date, design or history. The only other source, PeakVisor, describes a peak of the same name in Lorne Parish; neither source says the lookout stood on that peak, so any link is an inference. The Archives of New Brunswick community page for a place called Lower Blue Mountain (archives.gnb.ca/en-ca/communities/victoria/lorne/lower-blue-mountain) gives an approximate point of 47.03, -67.30, about 7 km from the record's point; it was not used. Do not confuse with Blue Mountain in Restigouche County (canada-lookouts.weebly.com/blue-mountain.html), a separate tower with its own history. Story is below the 120-word target because the evidence is thin. A human should decide whether this record is a tower site at all, or whether the 1960 NB tower list (P211/10229) would settle it.
